steps.en: Add a recipe entry: model, pinned engine image, framework, GPU runner, search space
steps.zh: 加一条配方：模型、固定版本的引擎镜像、框架、GPU 集群、扫描范围

steps.en: Append one entry at the very end of the changelog naming that config key
steps.zh: 在变更日志最末尾追加一条，写明这个配置键

steps.en: Open a PR and label it to run the full sweep
steps.zh: 开 PR，打上标签触发完整扫描

steps.en: Expands the new keys into a job matrix of parallelism × concurrency points
steps.zh: 把新增的配置键展开成并行度 × 并发数的任务矩阵

steps.en: Runs each point on its self-hosted Slurm GPU clusters: serve, load-test, eval
steps.zh: 在自家 Slurm GPU 集群上逐点跑：起服务、压测、跑评测

steps.en: After merge, ingests that sweep's artifacts into the public dashboard
steps.zh: 合并后把这次扫描的产物导入公开仪表板

value.en: Your engine + GPU recipe gets a throughput-vs-latency curve on hardware you don't own, re-measured as images move — not a one-off blog number
value.zh: 你的引擎 + GPU 配方在你没有的硬件上得到一条吞吐—延迟曲线，镜像更新后还会重测，不再是一次性的博客数字

sources: https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/main/inferencex-e2e/docs/configuration-procedures.md (Add a model + hardware recipe: nvidia-master.yaml / amd-master.yaml; Append the changelog safely: perf-changelog.yaml physical end)
https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md (PR review flow: full-sweep-fail-fast label, green full sweep, /use <run_id> reuse at merge)

https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/main/inferencex-e2e/docs/architecture.md (infx.matrix.plan/generate, run-sweep.yml fan-out, infx.launch on Slurm, merge-ingest.yml dispatch to InferenceX-app)
